race.comment: BUON AMICI (7) led them up last start at this track but couldn't fend them off late, ending up 0.4L off the winner. Had to cross from out wide there however and he draws a much better gate this time. Won't have to do as much work early and that can see him holding on at the finish. MORF (1) was only 1.9L off the winner last start despite finsihing midfield when setting the tempo from a wide barrier over 1200m. Drawn out again, but the rise to 1400m is no issue and Li's claim comes in handy. Can recapture his best form and bounce back in a big way. ALOTTA FIGHTING (6) has missed narrowly his past couple, flying to miss by 0.9L. A better draw this time can see him settlign a little closer in the run and if he runs to recent form, he'll be hard to fend off. WHITE HOT (11) can find the front today under Faithfull and return to winning ways. JUST SUBLIME (5) won't be far away.
